name: Courmayeur (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of yellow and white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Courmayeur (a blue lion rampant on white) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Courmayeur, a comune in Aosta Valley; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Courmayeur arms — blue lion rampant on white, crowned, within branches
